newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - SHARES MIXED, MOST BANKS UNMOVED.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - SHARES MIXED, MOST BANKS UNMOVED.

text.p: Lithuanian shares were mixed on Friday but most banking prices held steady, dealers said.
Snoras Bank and Ukio Bank were the only banking shares to rise, with Snoras advancing to 36.00 litas from 33.00 litas and Ukio climbing to 17.00 litas from 16.00 litas.
The Baltic Shipyard made a big gain, rising to 9.97 litas from 9.07 litas.
Denmark's Odense Shipyard earlier this week acquired a 43 percent stake in the company and has pledged to invest millions of dollars in the shipyard.
Most blue chips remained unchanged or fell.
Medienos Plaushas slipped to 13.10 litas from 14.00 litas and spirits producer Sema lost ten percent, falling to 7.47 litas from 8.30 litas.
The mood among dealers was bearish.
"We forecast that prices will continue falling next week and then stabilize at the end of the week," said Arvydas Jacikevicius of brokerage house Suprema.
He said that bearish markets across the region were taking a bite out of the Lithuanian equities market.
"The overall equities situation in Eastern Europe now is not so good and this is having an impact here," he said.
